description:
About the job 

Do you possess experience as Software Quality Assurance Tester, including being in a senior position with excellent communication skills, problem-solving oriented team-player with a positive  attitude? 

Are you ambitious and would relish the opportunity grow your career in a Romanian software  company? If the answer is ”yes” to these questions then we would love to hear from you. 


What you’ll be working on 

The role of a Software Quality Assurance Tester will act as part of the testing team to ensure the  testing functionalities of a C2 software applications, in line with internal engineering and quality  procedures, to include: 

▪ Creating and maintaining test documentation: test plans, test procedures, test reports, bug  reports; 

▪ Technical activities such as installation, configuration, software testing, technical support,  working at the company's offices and / or out of office (Beneficiary office) 

▪ Estimating, planning, and coordinating testing activities 

▪ Implement test environments, assist with tools and simulations 

▪ Ensure that quality issues and defects are appropriately identified, documented, tracked,  and resolved in the defect tracking system 

▪ Identifies, records, documents thoroughly and track bugs 

▪ Reviews requirements specifications and technical design documents to provide timely  and meaningful feedback 

▪ Creates detailed, comprehensive and well-structured test plans and test cases 

▪ When appropriate, designs, develops and executes automation scripts using open source  tools 

▪ Performs thorough regression testing when bugs are resolved 

▪ Develops operation and administration manuals for tested software functionalities ▪ Provides technical support in end-user training activities for software applications tested


Requirements: 

▪ Software testing principles (BlackBox Test, Smoke Test, Regression Test, etc.)

▪ Ability to understand and create test plans/test cases/testing reports 

▪ Strong QA skills for bug isolation and reporting and root cause analysis 

▪ Strong analytical skills, capability to understand complex standards and corellate  information from these documentation 

▪ Knowledge on methods for testing Windows desktop and Web applications

▪ Knowledge on testing various backend APIs using tools like Postman, SOAP UI

▪ Windows operating system and Active Directory knowledge 

▪ TCP / IP protocol stack knowledge 

▪ Ability to understand the business case and system requirements 

▪ Knowledge of English language at an average level, written and spoken 

▪ Good communication skills and ability to efficiently collaborate with development, IT  infrastructure and business analysis teams 


Qualifications 

▪ University degree in computer science, software engineering or equivalent

▪ 5+ years of working experience in testing 

 

Nice to have: 

∙ ISTQB certification will be highly advantageous. 

∙ Open to learning automation testing 

∙ Capacity to use AzureDevOps (or Team Foundation Server) 

∙ Military domain knowledge would be an advantage but it’s not a must 


What you’ll be joining

You will be joining an organization that is a private software company, provider of Command & Control systems for the Defense and Homeland Security Market and software solutions integrator.  With an experience in C2 systems of over 15 years, ISW delivered own solutions to Defense  (Land Forces) and Homeland Security entities in Romania.
